{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# v7.2: connector+scorer selective freeze
# Trainable: connector (11.8M) + scorer (0.1M), all else frozen (436.5M)
set -euo pipefail
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/acib
export WANDB_MODE=disabled MUJOCO_GL=egl PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl

SEED=${1:-42}
GPU=${2:-0}
OUTPUT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/acib_v7.2_connector_scorer_seed${SEED}"

python3 -u scripts/train_acib.py \
  --model_id lerobot/smolvla_libero \
  --dataset_id lerobot/libero \
  --data_root /root/autodl-tmp/libero_dataset \
  --hidden_dim 64 \
  --alpha 0.01 --beta 0.01 --beta_warmup_steps 1000 \
  --mode soft --condition_source language --conditioning_mode concat \
  --lambda_contrastive 0.1 --diversity_lambda 0.1 --lambda_ent 0.0 \
  --steps 20000 --batch_size 64 --lr 5e-5 --warmup_steps 1000 --grad_clip 1.0 \
  --save_freq 5000 --dtype bfloat16 \
  --gpu ${GPU} --seed ${SEED} \
  --freeze_mode connector_scorer --lambda_drift 0.1 \
  --output_dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

这是一个公平的消融对比，不需要任何修改。
